bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-mp4-doc-24bade)" || exit 61
out="$(docker logs --since 30m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1)" || exit 62
if printf '%s' "$out" | grep -Eiq 'wrong file identifier|file_id.*invalid';then exit 80;fi
if printf '%s' "$out" | grep -Eiq 'RICH_MESSAGE.*INVALID|RICH.*BLOCK.*INVALID';then exit 81;fi
if printf '%s' "$out" | grep -Eiq 'message can.t be edited|message to edit not found';then exit 82;fi
if printf '%s' "$out" | grep -Eiq 'media.*invalid|invalid.*media';then exit 83;fi
if printf '%s' "$out" | grep -Eiq '400.*Bad Request|400:.*Bad Request';then exit 84;fi
exit 85
